notes.title: Kickstarter is Now Live!
notes.content:
Little Monster's Kickstarter is now live and you can pledge your support for as low as $1! Stretch goals, video playthroughs, game details, opening cutscene preview, reward previews, and fund usage are all outlined in the campaign. Here's a preview of the reward tiers:

[list]
[*] [b]The Aspiring Little Monster![/b] $1 - In-game Mask Pack
[*] [b]Loyal Little Monster![/b] $15 - Mask Pack, Digital Game on Steam
[*] [b]Brave Little Monster![/b] $25 - Mask Pack, Digital Game on Steam, Digital eManual
[*] [b]Determined Little Monster![/b] $35- Mask Pack, Digital Game on Steam, Digital eManual, Digtial Art Book
[*] [b]Monster Savior![/b] $40 - Mask Pack, Digital Game on Steam, Digital eManual, Digital Art Book, Digital Strategy Guide
[*] [b]Master Hunter![/b] $60 - Mask Pack, Digital Game on Steam, Digital eManual, Digital Art Book, Digital Strategy Guide, Digital BTS Book
[/list]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/littlemonster/little-monster-a-fast-paced-beat-em-up-game]PLEDGE YOUR SUPPORT HERE![/url]

Let others know who might be interested! You have until [b]December 20th[/b] to pledge your support and earn rewards!

As always, thank you for all your support! See you in the monster realm!

notes.title: Support Little Monster for $1!
notes.content:
Loyal Monsters!

Times are tough and you shouldn't have to chose between supporting your favorite games and paying bills. That's why Little Monster's Kickstarter campaign will be offering $1 tiers for those who would like to support the game but may be strapped for cash right now. 

Here's the entire list of backer rewards planned for the campaign. Would love to hear your thoughts! 

[list]
[*] [b]The Aspiring Little Monster![/b] $1 - In-game Mask Pack
[*] [b]Loyal Little Monster![/b] $15 - Mask Pack, Digital Game on Steam
[*] [b]Brave Little Monster![/b] $25 - Mask Pack, Digital Game on Steam, Digital eManual
[*] [b]Determined Little Monster![/b] $35- Mask Pack, Digital Game on Steam, Digital eManual, Digtial Art Book
[*] [b]Monster Savior![/b] $40 - Mask Pack, Digital Game on Steam, Digital eManual, Digital Art Book, Digital Strategy Guide
[*] [b]Master Hunter![/b] $60 - Mask Pack, Digital Game on Steam, Digital eManual, Digital Art Book, Digital Strategy Guide, Digital BTS Book
[/list]
Check out the preview page [url=https://onedrr.com/ks/]HERE[/url]

OR

Head straight to the pre-launch Kickstarter page itself and follow the campaign [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/littlemonster/little-monster-a-fast-paced-beat-em-up-game]HERE[/url]

As always, thank you for all your support! See you in the monster realm!
